facts.fact: The High Court of the Federal Capital Territory applied the Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023 in a judgment delivered on 29 July 2026 (Justice Kayode Agunloye), holding Stanbic IBTC's retention and processing of two former customers' data unlawful for want of a lawful basis under the Act.

On 29 July 2026 the FCT High Court (suit CVI2190/25) ordered Stanbic IBTC Bank to pay N15 million in general damages and N500,000 costs to two former customers, to erase data it is not legally required to retain, and granted a perpetual injunction against further processing, finding violation of the Act, Section 37 of the Constitution and the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act, 2018.
A court awarded damages and erasure orders to data subjects directly under the Act on 29 July 2026 in a private suit instituted 10 June 2025.
